y-m-67-07.goal: Ku muuji tusaale lid ku ah in shuruudda f″(a)=0 keligeed aanay dhibic ka dhigayn dhibic leexasho, oo adigu sheeg waxa la hubinayo si ay u noqoto dhibic leexasho.
y-m-67-07.material:
Ka fiirso shaqada f(x) = xⁿ (n waa tiro dabiici ah oo ugu yaraan 3). Soosaarka labaad waa f″(x) = n(n−1)xⁿ⁻² iyo f″(0) = 0. (U akhri f″ sida: f labo prime.) y-m-67-05.topic: Hababka kala saarista kala duwan: derivative-ka shaqada exponential-ka iyo joogtada e
y-m-67-05.goal: Ku tijaabi qaaciido derivative oo la xafidey tirooyin, ku cidhiidhi xadka a ee m(a)=1 adigoo isticmaalaya jadwal, oo isku xidh in qiimahan uu yahay e iyo in (aˣ)′ = aˣ ln a.
y-m-67-05.material: Ha noqdo m(a) derivative-ka x=0 ee shaqada exponential-ka f(x) = aˣ (a>0, a≠1). Qeexitaanka, m(a) waa qiimaha (aʰ−1)/h u dhowaado marka h ku dhow yahay 0. Qiimayaasha hoose oo dhan waa qiyaas lagu xisaabiyey h=0.000001.
y-m-67-05.prereq.2: In garaafka shaqada exponential-ka aˣ uu yahay mid siman
y-m-67-05.s.s1.prompt: Subin wuxuu xifdiyey (aˣ)′ = x·aˣ⁻¹. Gelinta x=0 qaaciidadan waxay siinaysaa m(a)=0. Laakiin marka a=2, (2ʰ−1)/h waa ku dhowaad 0.718, 0.696, 0.693 marka h=0.1, 0.01, 0.001. Sidee u xukumi lahayd qaaciidada Subin?
y-m-67-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka akhri isbeddelka tirooyinka halka qiimuhu u socdo marka h u yaraado 0.1, 0.01, 0.001.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qiimaha ka yimid gelinta x=0 qaaciidada Subin dhig dhinac qiimayaasha jadwalka oo barbar dhig.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.a: 0.693 wuxuu ku dhow yahay 0, sidaas darteed qaaciidada Subin waxaa loo tixgelin karaa sax.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.a: Ma aragtay u janjeedhka ah xitaa haddii h la yareeyo, qiimuhu ma u socdo 0 laakiin wuxuu joogaa agagaarka 0.693?
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.b: Qiimayaasha jadwalka waxay joogaan agagaarka 0.69, sidaas darteed qaaciidadani sax ma aha.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad u akhriday sida caddayn marka h la yareeyo, qiimuhu wuxuu ku dhegaa lambar togan oo qaar halkii 0.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.c: h ma aha 0, sidaas darteed jadwalka macno ma laha, waana in aan aaminno qaaciidada la xifdiyey.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.c: Derivative-ku waa si sax ah qiimaha marka h u dhowaado 0. Jadwalku waa caddayn u socota qiimahaas.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.explain: Xitaa marka h la yareeyo, qiimuhu wuxuu ku ururaa agagaarka 0.693, ma aha 0. Sidaas darteed marka x=0, qaaciidada Subin x·aˣ⁻¹ = 0 ma waafaqsana jaleecada xariiqda taabanaysa marka a=2.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.prompt: Aad raadi a leh m(a)=1. Hubi xukunkaaga adigoo xogta hal-hal eegaya.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tallaabo kasta, hal sadar ku dheh haddii xogta cusubi taageerto ama beeniso male-gaaga.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qiimaha jadwalka iyo qiimaha ln a dhig dhinac isla a oo barbar dhig intee weyn ayuu farqigu yahay.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.info: m(2) ≈ 0.693, m(3) ≈ 1.099, m(4) ≈ 1.386. Marka a weynaado, m(a) sidoo kale wuu weynaadaa.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.ask: Ku dhowaad meeshee ayuu yahay a-ga leh m(a)=1?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.after: m(2)<1<m(3), sidaas darteed jawaabtu waxay u dhexeysaa 2 iyo 3. Laakiin dhinacee ayay ku dhow tahay weli waa male.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Ka yar 2. Sababtoo ah m(2) mar horeba wuxuu ku dhow yahay 1.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.a: m(2)≈0.693 wuu ka yar yahay 1. Marka a weynaado m wuu weynaadaa, sidaas darteed si loo gaaro 1 miyaanay ka weynaan 2?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.b: 2 iyo 3 dhexdooda, wuxuuna u egyahay inuu ku dhow yahay 3.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Tani waa xukun isticmaalay xaqiiqada ah 1 wuxuu ku dhow yahay 1.099 marka loo eego 0.693.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.c: 3 iyo 4 dhexdooda. Sababtoo ah m(3) weli wuu ka yar yahay 1.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.c: m(3)≈1.099 mar horeba wuu dhaafay 1. Eeg halka uu marka ugu horreysay dhaafayo 1.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.d: Wax kasta oo aad odhan karto waa inuu u dhexeeyo 2 iyo 3.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.d: Tani waa xukun taxaddar leh in saddex bar oo keliya, aadan aqoon booska saxda ah.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.info: Xisaabin dheeraad ah ka dib, m(2.5) ≈ 0.916, m(2.7) ≈ 0.993, m(2.8) ≈ 1.030.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.after: m(2.7)<1<m(2.8), sidaas darteed jawaabtu waxay u egtahay inay u dhexeyso 2.7 iyo 2.8. Qiimaha sax ah lama hagaajin karo jadwal.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.a: a=2.75 waa jawaabta saxda ah, si sax ah bartamaha 2.7 iyo 2.8.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Tani waxay sheegtay in qiime shaxda ku jirin uu sax yahay. Waa inaad hubisaa qiimaha dhabta ah ee m marka 2.75.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Waxay u muuqataa inay u dhexayso 2.7 iyo 2.8, laakiin qiimaha saxda ah lagama go'aamin karo shax.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Tani waxay cidhiidhisay xadka iyadoo qirtay xuduudaha shaxda.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Qiimaha si sax ah u ah 1 shaxda kuma jiro, sidaas darteed a noocaas ah ma jiro.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.c: m(a) wuxuu si joogto ah ula beddelmaa a, sidaas darteed qiime shaxda ku jirin micnaheedu maaha inaanu jirin.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.info: Tirada m(a)=1 loogu yeedho e, e ≈ 2.71828…. Sidoo kale m(a) = ln a (logaritamka dabiiciga ah ee a), sidaas darteed (aˣ)′ = aˣ ln a. La barbar dhig shaxda, ln 2 ≈ 0.693, ln 3 ≈ 1.099, ln 2.7 ≈ 0.993.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.ask: Qaaciidada asalka ah ee Subin sidee ula barbar dhigaysaa natiijadan?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.after: Marka x=0, qaaciidada Subin had iyo jeer waa 0, laakiin iska leexashada dhabta ah waa ln a. Haddii a≠1, markaas ln a≠0, sidaas darteed qaaciidada Subin waa khalad. m(a)=1 waa marka ln a=1, taasoo ah, a=e.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Qaaciidada Subin waxaa loo arki karaa inay sax tahay marka x=0 kaliya marka a=e.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Haddii a=e markaas m=1, laakiin qaaciidada Subin waxay bixisaa 0 marka x=0. Hubi in weli sax yahay.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Qiimayaasha shaxda ku jira oo la mid ah qiimayaasha ln a waa kadis keliya.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Way adag tahay in kadis loo arko in saddexda qiime dhammaantood ay isku waafaqaan ilaa meesha saddexaad ee jajab tobanlaha.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Marka x=0, qaaciidada Subin waxay bixisaa 0 qiimaha dhabta ahna waa ln a (≠0), sidaas darteed qaaciidadu waa khalad.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Waxaad ku xaqiijisay tibaax is-waafaq la'aanta shaxda tirooyinka ay muujisay.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.reflect: Nidaamku wuxuu ahaa: bilowga ku kalsoonaanta qaaciidada la xasuustay, ku burin tirooyin, cidhiidhinta xadka shaxda, ka dibna qeexidda (e) iyo tibaaxda sharaxaysa shaxda. Tallaabo kee ayay kalsoonidaadu ku beddeshay? Sidee u kala duwan yihiin waxa shaxdu samaysay iyo waxa tibaaxdu samaysay?
